source.title: Accelerate State of DevOps Report 2024, page 13 (Performance levels)
source.checked: Checked against the report's performance-levels table on page 13 (v. 2024.3) on 2026-11-23

Deploys per week.basis: DORA's High cluster deploys between once a day and once a week; Elite deploys on demand, several times a day; Medium between once a week and once a month

Change failure rate.basis: DORA's change fail rate is 5% for Elite, 20% for High, 10% for Medium and 40% for Low; 20% is the High cluster's

Deploys rolled back or followed by error.basis: a stand-in for change fail rate, held to DORA's High cluster figure of 20% (Elite 5%, Medium 10%, Low 40%); DORA measures change fail rate, not this proxy

no_suggestion.Lead time for change: the skill measures pull request open to merge; DORA measures commit to production, so its ranges do not apply
no_suggestion.Time to restore: the skill measures every incident from start to restore; DORA's failed deployment recovery time counts only failures a deployment caused, so its ranges do not apply
no_suggestion.Pull request review time: no published benchmark found for this definition
no_suggestion.Rework rate: no published benchmark found for this definition
no_suggestion.Developer experience index: each survey scores differently, so no general range applies
